描述_EN: metalworkers in ancient china made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors when they were accidentally unearthed centuries later. this bronze wine jar is called a zun in chinese. these vessels were buried with the dead.
描述_ZN: 古代中国的金属工匠用青铜制作了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 它们在几百年后意外出土时，成为了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 这个青铜酒罐在中国被称为 "尊"。 这些器皿与死者埋在一起。
